pages.title: Levis Echo
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r V$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Melee Weapons$(br2)§lEffect: §r Repeated hits on the same target stack echo marks; at 3 stacks they detonate for magic damage equal to 5% + (level-1)×2% of the target's max health, ignoring armor. Only works on targets with at least 50 max health; marks reset after 5 seconds without a hit.$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Entropy, Eternal Spark, and other melee damage/growth enchantments.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
